title: Android: Fragment shader active uniforms exceed GL_MAX_FRAGMENT_UNIFORM_VECTORS
body:
### Tested versions v4.5.beta5.official [c81fd6c51] with custom android template for debug symbols ### System information OnePlus8Pro (QKR1.191246.002), Android 11, Google SwiftShader, OpenGL ES 3.0 SwiftShader 4.1.0.7 ### Issue description When I upload new release (internal) to Google Play, _sentry.io_ reports error in SceneShaderGLES3 and CanvasShaderGLES3.
godot.log ``` Godot Engine v4.5.beta.custom_build.c81fd6c51 (2025-08-04 17:04:23 UTC) - https://godotengine.org 1: ERROR: SceneShaderGLES3: Program linking failed: Fragment shader active uniforms exceed GL_MAX_FRAGMENT_UNIFORM_VECTORS (261) at: _display_error_with_code (drivers\gles3\shader_gles3.cpp:259) ERROR: Method/function failed. at: _compile_specialization (drivers\gles3\shader_gles3.cpp:461) 1: ERROR: SceneShaderGLES3: Program linking failed: Fragment shader active uniforms exceed GL_MAX_FRAGMENT_UNIFORM_VECTORS (261) at: _display_error_with_code (drivers\gles3\shader_gles3.cpp:259) ERROR: Method/function failed. at: _compile_specialization (drivers\gles3\shader_gles3.cpp:461) 1: ERROR: SceneShaderGLES3: Program linking failed: Fragment shader active uniforms exceed GL_MAX_FRAGMENT_UNIFORM_VECTORS (261) at: _display_error_with_code (drivers\gles3\shader_gles3.cpp:259) ERROR: Method/function failed. at: _compile_specialization (drivers\gles3\shader_gles3.cpp:461) 1: ERROR: SceneShaderGLES3: Program linking failed: Fragment shader active uniforms exceed GL_MAX_FRAGMENT_UNIFORM_VECTORS (261) at: _display_error_with_code (drivers\gles3\shader_gles3.cpp:259) ERROR: Method/function failed. at: _compile_specialization (drivers\gles3\shader_gles3.cpp:461) WARNING: shader failed to compile, unable to bind shader. at: _version_bind_shader (./drivers/gles3/shader_gles3.h:217) OpenGL API OpenGL ES 3.0 SwiftShader 4.1.0.7 - Compatibility - Using Device: Google Inc. - Google SwiftShader GodotPlayGameServices plugin initialized successfully. [Firebase] >> The value for `databaseURL` is not configured. If you are not planning to use it, ignore this message. [Firebase] >> The value for `clientId` is not configured. If you are not planning to use it, ignore this message. [Firebase] >> The value for `clientSecret` is not configured. If you are not planning to use it, ignore this message. If you are not planning to use it, ignore this message. [Firebase] >> The value for `cacheLocation` is not configured. If you are not planning to use it, ignore this message. [Firebase] >> The value for `emulators` is not configured. If you are not planning to use it, ignore this message. [Firebase] >> The value for `workarounds` is not configured. If you are not planning to use it, ignore this message. 1: ERROR: CanvasShaderGLES3: Program linking failed: Fragment shader active uniforms exceed GL_MAX_FRAGMENT_UNIFORM_VECTORS (261) at: _display_error_with_code (drivers\gles3\shader_gles3.cpp:259) ERROR: Method/function failed. at: _compile_specialization (drivers\gles3\shader_gles3.cpp:461) ```
The error repeats few times then sentry.io reports IllegalStateException: ``` IllegalStateException: The specified child already has a parent. You must call removeView() on the child's parent first. ```
IllegalStateException StackTrace ``` android.view.ViewGroup in addViewInner at line 5235 android.view.ViewGroup in addView at line 5064 android.view.ViewGroup in addView at line 5004 androidx.fragment.app.FragmentStateManager in addViewToContainer at line 901 androidx.fragment.app.FragmentStateManager in createView at line 585 androidx.fragment.app.FragmentStateManager in moveToExpectedState at line 286 androidx.fragment.app.FragmentStore in moveToExpectedState at line 114 androidx.fragment.app.FragmentManager in moveToState at line 1685 androidx.fragment.app.FragmentManager in dispatchStateChange at line 3319 androidx.fragment.app.FragmentManager in dispatchActivityCreated at line 3237 androidx.fragment.app.FragmentController in dispatchActivityCreated at line 263 androidx.fragment.app.FragmentActivity in onStart at line 350 android.app.Instrumentation in callActivityOnStart at line 1674 android.app.Activity in performStart at line 8018 android.app.ActivityThread in handleStartActivity at line 3469 android.app.servertransaction.TransactionExecutor in performLifecycleSequence at line 221 android.app.servertransaction.TransactionExecutor in cycleToPath at line 201 android.app.servertransaction.TransactionExecutor in executeLifecycleState at line 173 android.app.servertransaction.TransactionExecutor in execute at line 97 android.app.ActivityThread$H in handleMessage at line 2068 android.os.Handler in dispatchMessage at line 106 android.os.Looper in loop at line 223 android.app.ActivityThread in main at line 7680 java.lang.reflect.Method in invokeNative java.lang.reflect.Method in invoke at line 423 com.android.internal.os.RuntimeInit$MethodAndArgsCaller in run at line 592 com.android.internal.os.ZygoteInit in main at line 947 ```
I assume OnePlus8Pro is google's testing device. This release was never published, just uploaded to Google Play. The error seems to happen at the exact start of the application (0ms - 30ms): I'm not using any shaders if that's important. It's a 2d game in Compatibility mode. I can't reproduce the issue on my phone. Let me know if you need more info. ### Steps to reproduce * setup sentry.io [1.0.0-alpha.3+c6b7259](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-godot/releases/tag/1.0.0-alpha.3) in godot 4.5 beta5 * export aab for android * upload the aab as new release to google play (no need to publish) I guess you will need low end device with the same GPU for manual testing ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) I'm not sure how to provide MRP with sentry.io setup and custom template, but I can assist with testing.
